en.title: Superstrip Algebras and Nonperturbative Spectra in Fermionic Theories
en.author: Zhihao Duan
en.text:
Joint work with Jin Chen, Qiang Jia and Sungjay Lee
arXiv:2609.12750 · 2026-09-11

pages.title: 从对称性约束孤子谱
pages.text: 研究有质量间隙的二维费米体系。同一真空上的激发是粒子，不同真空间的插值是孤子；目标是用对称性限制它们如何组成多重态。

en.title: Symmetry constraints on soliton spectra
en.text: In a gapped two-dimensional fermionic theory, equal asymptotic vacua give particles; distinct vacua give solitons. The aim is to constrain their multiplets using symmetry.

pages.title: 拓扑缺陷线超越群对称
pages.text: 群对称的缺陷线可逆。临界 Ising 模型的对偶线融合后却分解为两项，因此需要用融合范畴描述；第二式是背景例子。

en.title: From groups to non-invertible lines
en.text: Group-like defect lines are invertible. The Ising duality line instead fuses into a direct sum. This background example motivates replacing a group by a fusion category.

pages.title: 交点空间带有奇偶分次
pages.text: 费米理论的线交点既可为偶也可为奇。只记录融合的总重数会丢失统计信息；超融合范畴分别保留两类交点及其符号。

en.title: Graded junction spaces
en.text: Junctions may be even or odd. Total fusion multiplicities alone lose the statistics. A superfusion category retains both components and their sign rules.

pages.title: 简单缺陷线的两种类型
pages.text: m 型线只有偶自同态；q 型线还携带奇自同态，对应线上 Majorana 自由度。这里自同态必须作为超代数理解，不能只比较普通维数。

en.title: m-type and q-type simple lines
en.text: An m-type line has only an even endomorphism. A q-type line also supports an odd Majorana mode. The endomorphism superalgebra, rather than ordinary dimension alone, distinguishes them.

pages.title: 真空形成超模范畴
pages.text: 对称范畴描述可作用的线，超模范畴描述真空及线对真空的作用。以下考虑非可逆对称性破缺、费米奇偶性仍保留的相。

en.title: Vacua as a supermodule category
en.text: The symmetry category describes the lines; its supermodule describes vacua and the action on them. The phases studied retain fermion parity while breaking other categorical symmetries.

pages.title: 梯形图定义超条带算符
pages.text: 两侧竖线记录初末真空，横线表示对称缺陷，交点保留奇偶性。梯形图把几何操作变成作用于粒子和孤子空间的算符。

en.title: A ladder acts on soliton sectors
en.text: The vertical lines record boundary vacua, the rung is a symmetry line, and the two junctions retain their parity. The ladder represents an operator between excitation sectors.

diagram.title: 超条带算符的梯形示意

pages.title: 乘法与费米交换符号
pages.tex: \begin{gathered}\mathcal A_{\bar a}\mathcal A_{\bar b}\subseteq\mathcal A_{\overline{a+b}}\\(x\otimes y)(z\otimes w)=(-1)^{|y||z|}xz\otimes yw\end{gathered}
pages.text: 乘法由梯形图上下拼接，再用模范畴的结合变换化简。交换两个奇交点时出现负号；第二式说明所采用的超张量积约定。

en.title: Multiplication and the Koszul sign
en.text: Stack ladders vertically and reduce them with module associators. Exchanging odd junctions introduces a minus sign. The second equation records the super tensor-product convention.

pages.title: 为什么是弱 Hopf 超代数
pages.text: 余乘法组织多激发态，但只能拼接真空边界相容的扇区。单位的余乘法是相容性投影，通常不是整个张量积上的单位。

en.title: Why the Hopf structure is weak
en.text: The coproduct organizes multiple excitations while enforcing compatible intermediate vacua. Its value on the unit is a compatibility projector, generally not the identity on the full tensor product.

pages.title: 用本原幂等元分解表示
pages.text: 在半单情形，从相互正交的本原幂等元构造简单左模。需另行判断不同左理想是否同构，以及是否还要补入奇偶反转的表示。

en.title: Primitive idempotents and representations
en.text: Primitive orthogonal idempotents give simple left modules in the semisimple setting. Isomorphic summands must be identified, and parity-reversed representations need a separate check.

pages.title: 从表示读出粒子与孤子
pages.text: 箭图节点是真空，自环是粒子，连接不同节点的箭头是孤子。蓝色与红色区分偶、奇激发；同一不可约多重态中的态质量简并。

en.title: Reading a graded quiver
en.text: Nodes are vacua; loops denote particles and arrows between nodes denote solitons. Blue and red encode even and odd excitations. States in a single irreducible multiplet have equal mass.

pages.title: 费米 Fibonacci 例子
pages.text: 这里非平凡线为 m 型，但三线交点已经同时含偶、奇分量。它说明：线本身的类型与融合交点的奇偶维数是两层不同的数据。

en.title: The fermionic Fibonacci example
en.text: The nontrivial line is m-type, yet its trivalent junction space has both parities. The type of a simple line and the grading of fusion junctions are distinct pieces of information.

pages.title: q 型二元对称的融合
pages.text: 这个例子的非平凡线为 q 型。它可由 Ising 融合范畴的费米凝聚得到，必须保留附着于线上的 Majorana 自由度。

en.title: Fusion of the q-type binary symmetry
en.text: Here the nontrivial line is q-type. Fermion condensation of the Ising fusion category produces this example, including the Majorana degree of freedom on the line.

pages.title: 一对真空之间的四态表示
pages.text: 每个有向扇区包含一偶一奇，两个方向合计四态。箭图中的箭头表示真空之间的激发，不是经典轨迹。

en.title: A four-state soliton representation
en.text: Each orientation contains one even and one odd state, giving four states in total. The quiver records excitations between vacua, not classical trajectories.

diagram.title: 偶与奇的孤子及反孤子
diagram.en: Even and odd solitons in both directions
diagram.source: arXiv:2609.12750v1, Fig. 3, printed p. 20; simplified redrawing

pages.title: 二重超对称极小模型
pages.text: 以 A 型模型为起点，用 Landau–Ginzburg 超势描述其临界点。以下只研究保留超对称的最弱相关形变，并不把结论外推到任意形变。

en.title: The N=2 minimal-model starting point
en.text: Start with the A-series Landau–Ginzburg description. The following spectrum concerns the least relevant supersymmetry-preserving deformation, not an arbitrary perturbation.

pages.title: 形变后的 Chebyshev 超势
pages.text: 固定形变的总体尺度，低阶项组成 Chebyshev 多项式。Dijkgraaf–Verlinde–Verlinde (1991) 给出相关背景；这个特殊超势使真空和质量可显式计算。

en.title: The Chebyshev superpotential
en.text: Fix the overall deformation scale. The lower terms complete a Chebyshev polynomial, following Dijkgraaf–Verlinde–Verlinde (1991). This special form makes the vacua explicit.

pages.title: 相邻真空与共同质量
pages.text: 真空来自超势的临界点。此形变的稳定 BPS 孤子连接相邻真空；质量按所示超势归一化，改变总体尺度会同时改变所有质量。

en.title: Adjacent vacua and a common mass
en.text: Critical points determine the vacua. Stable BPS solitons in this deformation connect neighbours. The mass is normalized by the displayed superpotential; restoring the overall scale rescales every mass.

pages.title: 哪些缺陷线能保留下来
pages.text: 形变算符在线作用下的本征值必须等于该线的量子维数。先在玻色化理论中筛选满足条件的线，再进行费米凝聚，得到保留的超融合范畴。

en.title: Selecting surviving defect lines
en.text: The perturbing operator must have line eigenvalue equal to the quantum dimension. Select such lines in the bosonized theory, then apply fermion condensation to obtain the surviving superfusion category.

pages.title: 保留融合规则中的奇偶性
pages.text: 重数沿用截断的 SU(2) 融合范围，交点奇偶性则由两个标签的乘积决定。这里固定轨道代表元；物理多重态不依赖这一选择。

en.title: Parity in the surviving fusion rule
en.text: The range follows truncated SU(2) fusion, while the product of labels fixes junction parity. Fix orbit representatives; physical multiplets are independent of that choice.

pages.title: 超对称与范畴对称各控制什么
pages.text: 超对称配对同一有向扇区内的偶、奇态；保留的非可逆对称性进一步联系不同扇区。两者合起来解释整个 A 型孤子链的简并。

en.title: Two complementary symmetry constraints
en.text: Supersymmetry pairs even and odd states within an oriented sector. Non-invertible symmetry relates different sectors. Together they explain degeneracy along the A-type soliton chain.

pages.title: D 与 E 型来自保留的代数对象
pages.text: 可规范化的 Frobenius 代数对象在最弱相关形变下仍然保留，因此规范化与这次形变相容。E 型同样使用相应代数对象，但不能简单当作普通群商。

en.title: Obtaining the D and E series
en.text: The relevant Frobenius algebra survives the least relevant deformation, so gauging remains compatible with it. Exceptional models use their own algebra objects and are not simply ordinary group quotients.

pages.title: 二重超对称的真空指标
pages.text: Witten 指标由超对称真空的奇偶差给出，并在这些保留超对称的形变下保持。这些二重超对称例子中，真空全部为玻色型。

en.title: Vacuum indices for N=2
en.text: The Witten index is the signed count of supersymmetric vacua and is preserved by these deformations. The N=2 examples here have bosonic vacua throughout.

pages.title: 单重超对称的不同起点
pages.text: 单重超对称模型使用实超场。其保留范畴中会同时出现 m 型与 q 型线，因此真空奇偶性、表示箭图和指标都不同于二重超对称情形。

en.title: The N=1 starting point
en.text: Use a real superfield for the N=1 series. The surviving category contains both m-type and q-type lines, changing vacuum parity, representation quivers and indices.

pages.title: 选择流向有质量间隙的分支
pages.text: 取负耦合的有隙分支，临界点给出超对称真空。正耦合可触发无质量流，因此不能把两种符号下的红外结论混用。

en.title: Choosing the massive branch
en.text: Take the negative-coupling gapped branch. Critical points give supersymmetric vacua. Positive coupling can produce a massless flow, so the two infrared conclusions must be distinguished.

pages.title: 交替的真空奇偶性
pages.text: 取偶标签为 m 型、奇标签为 q 型，真空依次交替排列。右图示意六、八模型的五个真空：三个偶、两个奇，指标为一。

en.title: Alternating vacuum parity
en.text: Even labels give m-type vacua and odd labels give q-type vacua. The schematic SM(6,8) potential has three even and two odd vacua, giving index one.

diagram.title: 五个交替奇偶的真空
diagram.source: arXiv:2609.12750v1, Fig. 9, printed p. 34; simplified redrawing

pages.title: D 与 E 型的指标检查
pages.text: 这里完整写出模不变量的标签对，避免混淆两类 D 型。固定所示指标的整体符号；计算检验了临界理论与有隙真空描述的一致性。

en.title: Index checks in the D and E series
en.text: Keep the full modular-invariant label pairs to distinguish the D-series choices. Use the displayed overall sign convention. These indices check agreement between critical and gapped descriptions.

pages.title: 混合反常与半整数费米数
pages.tex: \begin{gathered}\mathcal N=2,\ A_2:\quad L_1^2=\mathbb C^{0|1}L_0\\\langle\mathrm{sol}|e^{2\pi iF}|\mathrm{sol}\rangle=-1\quad\Longrightarrow\quad F\in\mathbb Z+\tfrac12\end{gathered}
pages.text: 模结合变换记录破缺对称性与保留费米奇偶性的混合反常。局域于孤子扇区的作用给出半整数费米数；这不是改变整个体系的奇偶算符平方。

en.title: A mixed anomaly and fractional charge
en.text: Module associators encode the mixed anomaly. Its localized action on a soliton sector forces half-integral fermion number. This does not change the square of the global parity operator.

pages.title: 从超势的相位读出分数部分
pages.text: 连续对称性计算给出独立解释：孤子两端的费米质量相位差决定诱导电荷的分数部分。沿用 Goldstone–Wilczek (1981) 的方法，并注意相位分支带来的整数差。

en.title: The phase of the fermion mass
en.text: A complementary calculation relates the fractional induced charge to the phase difference of the fermion mass at the two ends. It follows Goldstone–Wilczek (1981); branch choices can shift the integer part.

pages.title: 单重超对称的对照
pages.text: 此时破缺线为 q 型，得到整数型费米数。由于没有相同的连续 R 对称性，不能直接照搬上一板的连续电流推导，仍需使用模结合数据。

en.title: The N=1 contrast
en.text: The broken line is q-type and the fermion number is integral. Without the same continuous R-symmetry, the preceding current derivation cannot be copied; module associators remain essential.

pages.title: 把孤子态变成边界算符
pages.text: 态与算符对应把粒子变成同一边界上的算符，把孤子变成改变边界条件的算符。表示问题因此可以转到边界拓扑场论中研究。

en.title: From soliton states to boundary operators
en.text: State-operator correspondence turns particles into operators on one boundary condition and solitons into boundary-changing operators. This gives a topological route to the representation problem.

pages.title: 边界 SymTFT 的三面结构
pages.text: 对称边界保存范畴数据，物理边界承载动力学，侧边界上的线表示边界激发。两处交角连接这些描述；右图用截面表示体理论与边界之间的关系。

en.title: Three boundaries in SymTFT
en.text: The symmetry boundary stores categorical data, the physical boundary stores dynamics, and side-boundary lines represent boundary excitations. The section shows the relation between the bulk and its boundaries.

diagram.title: 体理论与三类边界
diagram.source: arXiv:2609.12750v1, Fig. 19, printed p. 55; simplified redrawing

pages.title: 保留红外的费米统计
pages.text: 很重的中性费米子在低能中退耦，但统计信息不能丢失。费米单位线保存这层数据，并帮助边界构造补全正则表示分解中遗漏的奇偶反转表示。

en.title: Retaining fermionic statistics in the infrared
en.text: A heavy neutral fermion decouples dynamically but leaves statistics behind. The fermionic identity line retains this information and helps recover parity-shifted representations missed by a regular-module decomposition.

pages.title: 结果的适用范围
pages.text: 一般构造不要求超对称或可积性；这些模型提供了具体检验。它约束允许的多重态与简并，但单靠对称性不能决定所有态是否存在、绝对质量或完整散射矩阵。

en.title: What the construction determines
en.text: The construction does not require supersymmetry or integrability. It constrains allowed graded multiplets and degeneracies; symmetry alone does not fix their occurrence, absolute masses or the full scattering matrix.
